name: ccpm
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for lovaizu projects

plugins.name: rn
plugins.description: Say what you want, roughly: rn works out with you what you really want, carries the work through, has each result used by an agent that knows nothing of how it was made before you see it, and calls you back only for the plan, design, and deliverable sign-offs and the decisions that are yours. The session lives in git, so it resumes across conversations.

plugins.name: writ
plugins.description: Makes a document read as if a person wrote it for its reader, so you can hand it on without rereading it and judge it from a short report alone.

plugins.name: pith
plugins.description: Learn where the receiver of your work falls short, from what happened when a separate AI that does not know the discussion used it: a document, a prompt, code, tests or a plugin. Each point names its place and quotes what happened.

plugins.name: fw
plugins.description: The common base of the plugins that have AI make something for you: the task flow with a maker, a first user and a learner, a record that resumes after the conversation is cleared, and checks that keep each step from starting without what it needs.
